title: A Task-Level Bias Taxonomy for Historical Image Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.26019v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In recent decades, galleries, libraries, archives, and museums (GLAM institutions) have digitised vast amounts of cultural heritage material, including historical imagery. A major challenge in making these collections publicly accessible is enabling effective search and discovery. Many historical images contain incomplete, sparse, or no descriptive metadata. Consequently, machine learning (ML) methods are increasingly being used to generate or enrich metadata to improve the searchability of such collections. However, artificial intelligence (AI)-based systems can reproduce or amplify existing biases, particularly when applied to historical imagery. translated_title: 面向历史图像检索的任务级偏差分类法
translated_abstract: 近几十年来，画廊、图书馆、档案馆和博物馆（GLAM机构）已经数字化了大量文化遗产资料，包括历史图像。让这些馆藏能够被公众访问的一大挑战在于实现有效的搜索与发现。许多历史图像包含不完整、稀疏或缺失的描述性元数据。因此，机器学习（ML）方法正被越来越多地用于生成或丰富元数据，以提升这类馆藏的可搜索性。然而，基于人工智能（AI）的系统可能会重现或放大现有偏差，尤其是在应用于历史图像时。诸如训练模型所用数据与实际应用的历史图像之间的差异、图像质量退化、单色照片，以及历史上存在偏见或不完整的描述等因素，都可能降低模型性能，并在搜索与检索中引入偏差。
tldr: 本文针对历史图像检索场景提出了一种任务级的偏差分类法，系统梳理了AI系统在历史图像搜索与检索中可能引入偏差的各类因素。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a task-level bias taxonomy for historical image retrieval, systematically categorizing the various factors through which AI systems can introduce bias into the search and retrieval of historical imagery.
